clauses.name: ready_families
clauses.required: >= 1 family meeting every adequacy clause alone (30 events, 20 effective at 168h, 3 publishers, 1 provider, 180 days, 80% coverage)

clauses.name: point_in_time_integrity
clauses.required: <= 5% of resolved, uncorrected events with impossible timestamps

clauses.name: event_time_from_publication
clauses.required: >= 90% of point-in-time-valid events aligned to a publication time
